name: 04-failed-query-keeps-watermark
description: The poll's query fails (Salesforce 500): the flow fails before the batch runs, so nothing is logged and the watermark is not updated; the next poll retries from the same value.

source.reference: salesforce-data-synchronization-using-watermarking-and-batch-processing/src/main/app/watermarking.xml (flow triggerFlow: poll fixed-frequency 10 s, watermark variable=timestamp default-expression=YESTERDAY selector=MAX selector-expression=#[payload.LastModifiedDate], sfdc:query 'SELECT Id,Name,LastModifiedDate FROM Contact WHERE LastModifiedDate > #[flowVars['timestamp']]'; batch:job watermarkingBatch Batch_Step logger 'Contact recently modified: #[payload]'); README 'How it Works'

queryParams.q: SELECT Id,Name,LastModifiedDate FROM Contact WHERE LastModifiedDate > 2015-06-17T12:05:42.000Z
SELECT Id,Name,LastModifiedDate FROM Contact WHERE LastModifiedDate > 2015-06-17T12:05:42.000Z
